entities.summary: Francisco José Alcaraz Martos is a Spanish politician, member of the Vox party, and activist. He's served as president and spokesman for the Asociación de Víctimas del Terrorismo between 2004 and 2008. He is also the founder and president of the association Voces contra el Terrorismo.

entities.summary: Francisco José Alcaraz Martos is a Spanish politician, member of the Vox party, and activist. He's served as president and spokesman for the Asociación de Víctimas del Terrorismo between 2004 and 2008. He is also the founder and president of the association Voces contra el Terrorismo.
